specification_selection.criterion: sign-stable on all folds; among those, highest median AUC, then most variables retained, then strongest regularization. Candidates are the named anchors plus backward elimination from the full variable pool, regenerated from the data on every run, so a variable enters when it holds a direction and leaves when it stops.
specification_selection.stability_cost_note: median AUC given up by requiring every coefficient to hold its sign across all folds. Reported, not used as a veto; a gap beyond 0.05 is a hard stop.
change_reasons: projects_since_2024: sign stable this run, positive in all folds, median coefficient +0.2592
existing_dc_count: sign stable but not selected; another specification scored higher under the registered criterion
n_projects_tracked: sign stable but not selected; another specification scored higher under the registered criterion
pct_bachelors_plus: coefficient changed sign across folds, ranging -0.0168 to +0.0713, so its direction is not supported by the data

calibration.note: raw scores are compressed by shrinkage; the model includes a cross-fitted logistic recalibration layer. calibrated_score in the scores file is cross-fitted: no county's calibration was fit on itself. Post slope near 1 and intercept near 0 indicate the calibrated scores are honest probabilities.
